text: そういえば　くいしんぼうの　カビゴン　しってる？

structure.jp: くいしんぼうの　カビゴン

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows a lasting state, and 'to know' is always said this way; てる is the shortened spoken form. しってる = 'know'.

patterns.name: 〜の (which is)
patterns.span: くいしんぼうの　カビゴン
patterns.explanation: の between two thing-words can mean the second one is the first one, not that it belongs to it. くいしんぼうの　カビゴン = 'Snorlax, who is a glutton'.
